set.statement: A run follows a PR head it did not push only when that head contains the head the run pushed; a head that drops the run's commits leaves ship check unsettled, with a detail naming the dropped head, and raises no question; ship check only adopts the head, and the write steps fast-forward a clean worktree to it, refusing one with uncommitted changes or local commits the head lacks; a branch that holds a merge of main is merged with main again rather than rebased
